prompt_text: What is a good martial arts school for kids in St. Peters MO?
answer_verbatim:
A good **kids’ martial arts school in St. Peters, MO** is **World Martial Arts Academy** at **1057 Cave Springs Blvd.** It specifically offers **kids martial arts classes**, a **preschool program**, and a **teen program**, and its listed kids tuition is **$159 per month** with **no long-term contract** and **no cancellation fee**.[1][5][10][12]

Other solid options in St. Peters include **All Star Karate Academy** on **Jungermann Rd.**, which offers a **free introductory program** and teaches **Isshinryu Karate**; **ATA Martial Arts- St. Peters** on **Mexico Rd.**; and **Gracie Barra St. Peters** on **953 Jungermann Rd.**, which offers **kids jiu-jitsu** for ages **4+**.[2][3][6][9][17]

If you want the best fit, the main decision point is the style:
- **Karate / traditional martial arts:** World Martial Arts Academy or All Star Karate Academy.[3][5][10]
- **Jiu-jitsu / grappling:** Gracie Barra St. Peters or Onyx Grappling.[3][7][17]
- **Kickboxing / MMA:** All Saints Muay Thai Gym.[2]

A practical way to choose is to visit one or two schools, ask about the child’s age group, trial class options, instructor experience, and class size, and compare the atmosphere in person.[4]
